1.explanation: The code uses Puppeteer to launch a Chrome instance with remote debugging enabled. Lighthouse is then run on the specified URL with the PWA category selected. The issue is reproduced by observing the hanging behavior during the 'Loading page & waiting for onload' step. This setup mimics the environment described in the bug report, allowing for testing and debugging of the issue.
1.bug_scenario: The bug occurs when running a Lighthouse audit for a Progressive Web App (PWA) using Chrome 63.0.3239.132. The audit hangs indefinitely at the 'Loading page & waiting for onload' step. This happens both with the native audit and the Lighthouse extension version 2.8.0. The issue is observed on the page https://nicolas-hoizey.com/2017/01/how-much-data-should-my-service-worker-put-upfront-in-the-offline-cache.html and all pages of the site.
